items.title: Airbus Helicopters completes H140 hot-and-high tests in the US

items.fulltext:
Airbus Helicopters has completed a four-month flight test campaign in the United States for its new H140

The campaign, which ran from 13 June to 8 October, covered three locations in the American Southwest and Rocky Mountains.

Engineers recorded more than 130 flight hours and completed over 800 landings, gathering performance data to support certification and establish the helicopter’s approved operating envelope.

The US campaign began in Lake Havasu City, Arizona, where temperatures reached 45°C and above during June and July.

The aircraft was then flown to Leadville, Colorado, where the airport sits at approximately 10,000 feet above sea level. Tests also took place around Mount Pennsylvania at altitudes exceeding 13,000 feet.

Engineers examined how the helicopter handled hovering, takeoffs, and landings under demanding combinations of altitude and payload.
